description: Maintains ephemeral multi-turn dialogue history, short-term sliding window buffers, and session turn metadata.

turnBuffer.content: What is the meaning behind the blooming heart tree?
It represents devotion taking physical form—rooted silently in patient earth, reaching upward through every quiet twilight, and blossoming into hundreds of glowing heart leaves.
I want to send a wish for someone special.
Hold the glowing heart at the base of the tree, write your thoughts, and release it toward the Heart-Sun.

activeSessions.sessionSummary: User explored the philosophical significance of the 16-stage heart tree and initiated a heartfelt wish release in Stage 16.
